wb.title: Womens Fitness Planner Bundle Google Sheets, Workout Planner, Water Tracker, Step Tracker, Body Measurements, Self Care Tracker, Pink
wb.desc:
5 Google Sheets trackers for women in one pink download: the Women's Workout Planner, the Water Intake Tracker, the Step Tracker, Body Measurements and the Self-Care Tracker. Plan your workouts, drink your water, hit your steps, see the progress the scale misses and look after yourself. Cheaper than buying all 5 separately.

You get 5 separate Google Sheets: one PDF with a link to each. Made for your phone in the free Google Sheets app, and works on a laptop too. Not for Excel or Numbers, and not a printable.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: open the PDF, tap each tracker and press "Make a copy". Nothing is shipped.

WOMEN'S WORKOUT PLANNER
• 12 weeks, day by day. Pick a workout and tick Done
• Up to 8 workouts of your own: glutes, Pilates, yoga, walks, home or gym
• Weekly goal, week streak and all 12 weeks at a glance

WATER INTAKE TRACKER
• Type how many glasses you drank. One number a day
• ml or oz, your glass size, your goal
• Streak, 7-day average and goal days

STEP TRACKER
• Type your steps and the distance fills in
• Your daily step goal, km or miles
• Streak, 7-day average and goal days this month

BODY MEASUREMENTS
• Weight, waist, hips, chest, arm and thigh. Skip any you don't track
• cm or inches, kg or lb
• Start vs now for every measure, plus your last six check-ins

SELF-CARE TRACKER
• Six self-care habits of your own to tick each day
• Pick your mood and add one good thing each day
• Streak and this week's score

IN ALL 5
• 3 colour themes: Pink, Light and Dark
• No subscription. Yours to keep

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the PDF after purchase
2. Tap a tracker and press "Make a copy"
3. Open the Start tab in each copy and follow the steps

GOOD TO KNOW
• It needs a free Google account
• Want a full 12-week program? See our Glutes & Abs Workouts in the shop
• Want just one? Each tracker is also sold on its own in our shop
• These are tracking logs, not medical, nutrition or fitness advice
• Personal use only. Please don't share or resell the files or links
• Because it's a digital item, returns aren't accepted, but message me if anything doesn't work and I'll fix it

Designed and built by Kova Studio. AI tools helped during the build.
